stem: Which statement describes an action that most likely resulted in a chemical reaction?

options.label: A
options.text: A pan of water was heated on a stove, and steam formed.

options.label: B
options.text: A liquid was mixed with another liquid, and a precipitate formed.

options.label: C
options.text: A liquid was sprayed into the air, and a sweet odor was smelled.

options.label: D
options.text: A child blew through a wand filled with soap, and bubbles were produced.
